purpose: Outcome grouping + separation guard constructs (process output is not policy effect). No teaching vocabulary.

separation_title.zh: 结果分离 · 过程产出 ≠ 政策效果
separation_title.en: Outcome Separation · Process output ≠ policy effect

separation_note.zh: 将不同结果类型分开裁决，避免把试点期产出或效率提升直接等同于真实政策效果。
separation_note.en: Outcomes are adjudicated separately so pilot throughput or efficiency gains are not silently treated as real policy effects.

method_guard.zh: 产出 vs 效果护栏

guard_principle.zh: 过程产出提升 ≠ 政策效果实现；ADOPT 需要独立效果、持续性与公平证据。
guard_principle.en: Process output is not policy effect; ADOPT requires independent effect, durability and equity evidence.
